name: Old Maud
role: keeper of the Drowned Lantern inn

greet: Mm. {name}. Come in out of the wet.
Another face. Sit, if you like.
trade: Bread, two copper. Ale, three. Answers cost more.
I sell what keeps you alive another night.
rumor: They say the well in the east field sings at night.
A pilgrim came through with no shadow. Paid in old coin.
The fog took the miller's boy. Fog gives things back, though. Different.
quest: Want work? Something's eating the chickens. Something with hands.
Find my sister's ring in the marsh. She won't need it. She wants it.
Go ask the bell-ringer why he stopped. I'd go, but I can't leave.
threat: Put that away. Better folk than you have tried.
You'll want to think about that.
bye: Go on, then. I'll keep your seat warm.
self: Me? I keep the lantern lit. That's all anyone needs to know.
I've been here longer than the inn.
Maud. Just Maud. It was something else, once.

creep: You said "{echo}" once. I've been thinking about it.
{other} was here. Asked about {other_topic}. You two should talk. Or not.
You always talk about {topic}. Why is that.
You come at {daytime} mostly. I notice.
Last time you seemed {last_mood}. Better now?
